scene.speaker: tomas
scene.bubble: GOOOAL! Football at break, basketball after school, swimming on Monday… sport is my favourite word!
scene.intro: GOOOAL! Tomás scores and the whole team shouts. He plays football at break, basketball after school and he swims on Mondays. Nico prefers tennis, because you can play it with only one friend. Let's play! says Tomás every single day, with the ball already in his hands. What sport do YOU play? Choose your team and come to the field!

data.title: So do I!
data.intro: Another way to say me too — a bit bigger, and grown-ups love it: So do I.
data.can: I can answer So do I! when my friend and I do the same thing.

examples.text: Tomas: I play football. — Nico: So do I!
Tomas: I like swimming. — Nico: So do I!
Tomas: I want a new ball. — Nico: So do I!

rules: After I like…, I play…, I want… you answer: So do I.
The words go in this order: So — do — I. Not "So I do".
Say a sport you play and let your partner answer "So do I!"

items.sentence: — I want a ball. — So do ___!
— I go swimming on Fridays. — So ___ I!
